title: Digital Marketing for Small Businesses
excerpt: How to promote your business without spending a lot of money. Practical guide with free tools.
author: Tu Emprendimiento
content:
Digital marketing doesn't have to be expensive to be effective. In fact, the best strategies for small businesses use free or very cheap tools. Here's how to do it.

**WhatsApp Business is your best friend**
If you haven't installed it yet, do it now. WhatsApp Business is free and has powerful tools: automated responses, product catalogs, labels to organize clients. It's the first thing you should configure before thinking about any other platform.

**Google My Business**
If you have a physical business (an office, a store), register your business on Google My Business. It's free and makes you appear in local searches. When someone searches "business consultant Asunción", you want to show up there.

**Simple but consistent content**
You don't need to be a professional content creator. A phone and honesty are enough. Show your work, share tips, tell client stories (with their permission). Consistency matters more than perfection.

**Don't try to be everywhere**
Choose maximum 2 platforms. If you sell to young people, focus on Instagram. If your audience are professionals, LinkedIn might be better. Don't spread your energy across 5 platforms at once.
